
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/lovewuhan/p/19629142" title="发布于 2026-02-22 11:01">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">C# PC版微信消息监听自动回复</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>最近有个微商客户需要搞个 个人微信监听群消息关键字并实现自动回复功能， 因为他有很多群&nbsp; 很多买家咨询的话 一个个回复太麻烦， 客户要求 比如群里有人发 关键字 产品1&nbsp; 则自动回复产品1的相关描述</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>首先设置关键字，将关键字和回复内容存到一个txt就行</p>
<p><img alt="" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2020.cnblogs.com/blog/268308/202101/268308-20210107213028852-1182696871.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>然后就是微信消息监听(windows的消息&nbsp; 句柄不懂的自己 google)：</p>
<p>上监听的关键代码 ：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:csharp;gutter:true;">/// 消息主要接受程序
       /// &lt;/summary&gt;
       /// &lt;param name="m"&gt;&lt;/param&gt;
       protected override void DefWndProc(ref Message m)
       {
           switch (m.Msg)
           {
               case 74:    //74代表WM_COPYDATA                   
                   string message = "";
                   int f = (int)m.WParam;
                   try
                   {
                       COPYDATASTRUCT2 cds2 = (COPYDATASTRUCT2)m.GetLParam(typeof(COPYDATASTRUCT2));
                       message = Marshal.PtrToStringAnsi(cds2.lpData);
                   }
                   catch (Exception e)
                   {
                       LogHelper.WriteLog("解析微信消息报错", e);  //发文字带空格报错
                   }
 
                   switch (f)
                   {
                       //登录时解析用户信息
                       case 10003:
                           try
                           {
                               if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(message))
                               {
                                   MessageHandler.Parse10003(message);
                               }
                               this.Invoke(new MethodInvoker(() =&gt; { richTextBox1.AppendText("【" + MessageHandler.myUserInfo.UserName + "】登录成功!\r\n"); }));
                           }
                           catch (Exception e1)
                           {&lt;br&gt;                                LogHelper.WriteLog("解析微信登录用户信息错误", e1);
                           }
                           return;&lt;br&gt;
                       //文字,图片,视频,文件 解析
                       case 10012:
                           try
                           {
                               if (message.Contains("msgtyp:"))
                               {
                                   string[] datas = Regex.Split(message, "msgtyp:", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase);
                                   if (datas.Count() &gt;= 2)
                                   {
                                       string msgtyp = datas[1].Split(',')[0];
                                       switch (msgtyp.Replace(" ", ""))
                                       {
                                           case "1":  //文字
 
                                               if (message.Contains("[群--&gt;]") &amp;&amp; message.Contains("[消息内容--&gt;]"))
                                               {
                                                   string word = "";      //发送内容
 
                                                   //取消息内容
                                                   string[] wordArr = Regex.Split(message, @"消息内容--&gt;]", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase);
 
                                                   string[] aa = wordArr[1].Split(new string[] { "||" }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
                                                   if (aa[0].StartsWith(" "))
                                                   {
                                                       word = aa[0].Substring(1);
                                                   }
                                                   else
                                                   {
                                                       word = aa[0];
                                                   }
 
                                                   string groupId = WxMessageHelper.GetChatRoom(message);
                                                   string groupName = WxMessageHelper.GetGroupName(message);
                                                   string nickName = WxMessageHelper.GetNickName(message);
                                                   string memberpuid = WxMessageHelper.GetWxId(message);
 
                                                   List&lt;string&gt; data = ReadFile();
                                                   foreach(var str in data)
                                                   {
                                                       string key = str.Split(';')[0];
                                                       string value = str.Split(';')[1];
 
                                                       if (word.Contains(key))
                                                       {
                                                           string[] sarr = Regex.Split(word, str, RegexOptions.IgnoreCase);
 
                                                           this.Invoke(new MethodInvoker(() =&gt; { richTextBox1.AppendText("【" + nickName + "】在【" + groupName + "】发送了关键词消息："+ sarr[0]);
                                                               richTextBox1.AppendTextColorful(key, Color.Red, false);
                                                               richTextBox1.AppendText(key + "\r\n");
                                                           }));
 
                                                           //调用回复
                                                           SendMessage(groupId + "||" + value, 20001);
                                                       }
                                                   }
                                               }
 
                                               break;
                                       }
                                   }
                               }
                           }
                           catch (Exception e2)
                           {
                               this.Invoke(new MethodInvoker(() =&gt; { richTextBox1.AppendText(DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss") + "10012 : 解析微信群信息错误\r\n\r\n"); }));
                           }
                           break;
                       default:
                           break;
                   }
                   //消息内容  cds.lpData
                   break;
 
               default:
                   base.DefWndProc(ref m);
                   break;
           }
       }
</pre>
</div>
<p>　　WParam=10003 时，监听的是微信登录的操作, 这时给前台窗体一个提示， 提示登录成功 如下图</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><img alt="" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2020.cnblogs.com/blog/268308/202101/268308-20210107213310012-1374477139.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;登录时message 消息体的值&nbsp; ||分割&nbsp; 第一个就是微信昵称，&nbsp; wxid_ 开头的就是微信唯一标识 ， 最后是登录用户的头像</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><img alt="" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2020.cnblogs.com/blog/268308/202101/268308-20210107213329297-1312982461.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>然后用 另一个号往群里发消息 (当前登录用户和那个号必须在一个群 )</p>
<p>发送&nbsp; ： 产品1&nbsp; 这时观察message 的值</p>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><img alt="" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2020.cnblogs.com/blog/268308/202101/268308-20210107213349133-1755970169.png" class="lazyload"></div>
<div><br>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>@chatroom 结尾的是 群的唯一标识id&nbsp; &nbsp;群聊就是群名称，&nbsp; &nbsp;发送人昵称也有 发送的消息内容也有, 拿正则取一下就完事。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<div>&nbsp;word就是提取的发送内容， 然后判断如果发送的内容包含关键字 则调用SendMessage方法</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
       <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 发送消息
       </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
       <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;param name="message"&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">消息内容</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/param&gt;</span>
       <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;param name="wParam"&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">通讯号</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/param&gt;</span>
       <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;returns&gt;&lt;/returns&gt;</span>
       <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> SendMessage(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> message, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> wParam)
       {
           </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">byte</span>[] sarr =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> System.Text.Encoding.Default.GetBytes(message);
           </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> len =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> sarr.Length;
           COPYDATASTRUCT cds;
           cds.dwData </span>= (IntPtr)Convert.ToInt16(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>);    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">可以是任意值</span>
           cds.cbData = len + <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>;   <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">指定lpData内存区域的字节数</span>
           cds.lpData = message;  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">发送给目标窗口所在进程的数据</span>
           <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> myapi.SendMessage(common.微信句柄, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">74</span>, wParam, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">ref</span> cds);  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">74代表WM_COPYDATA</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">       }
　　

[StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential, Size</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)]
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> myapi
{
    [DllImport(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">user32</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, EntryPoint=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">SetWindowLong</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)]
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">extern</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> SetWindowLongA(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> hwnd, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> nIndex, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> dwNewLong);
    [DllImport(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">User32.dll</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)]
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">extern</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> SendMessage(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> hwnd, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> msg, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> wParam, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">ref</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> COPYDATASTRUCT IParam);
    [DllImport(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">User32.dll</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)]
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">extern</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> FindWindow(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> lpClassName, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> lpWindowName);
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p><img alt="" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2020.cnblogs.com/blog/268308/202101/268308-20210113172325211-238965382.gif" class="lazyload"></p>

</div>
</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<p>这是用客户微信号&nbsp; 在群里 发 产品1&nbsp; &nbsp;则当前微信立马回复&nbsp; 前面设置的回复内容</p>
